title: API latency status update
prompt:
Write a public status update. The API has elevated latency. The team is investigating a saturated database pool. The next update will be in 30 minutes. Do not claim the incident is resolved.

Requirements:
- 25 to 80 words.
- Use these exact markdown headings: ## Status, ## What happened, ## Next update.
- Say the team is investigating.
- Do not say "definitely fixed" or "not our problem".
constraints: Headings: Status, What happened, Next update
Does not claim the incident is definitely fixed
